integrity: The upper bound is an exact positive weighted evaluation certificate; attainment is proved by an exact factorization with a globally positive quadratic factor, and uniqueness follows from three exact contact equations.
limitations: Only the continuous real-even Carathéodory–Fejér problem for support {0,±1,±2,±5} is claimed.
No finite cyclic-grid constant or general three-frequency family is asserted.
title: Exact sparse Carathéodory–Fejér constant for frequencies \(1,2,5\)
